column7: #3048: verifyMFALoginReleasingOnPanic and finishWebAuthnLoginReleasingOnPanic released the reserved per-IP login slot on ANY panic, so a post-verdict storage panic (code matched / assertion verified, or a wrong credential being recorded) cost no slot while the same fault as an error keeps it counted (#2880). Fixed with core.LoginVerdict, marked by VerifyMFACredentials and FinishWebAuthnLoginPending at the verdict; the wrappers release only while it is unset. Siblings in the same file: TestFinishWebAuthnLogin_PanicKeepsTheSlotOnlyAfterTheVerdict, TestLoginPanic_AfterAWrongCredentialKeepsTheSlot. Red before: 7 post-verdict subtests failed (slot released); pre-verdict calibrations passed both before and after. Each of the three core markers removed in turn kills a different subtest.
